prompt:
Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): a sheet of 6 separate harvest fruits and vegetables: a red apple, a small orange pumpkin, an ear of corn in a green husk, a golden pear, a bunch of purple grapes and a carrot, each glossy. Drawn large with nothing cropped or hidden. Canvas: a landscape 3:2 holding exactly 6 separate pieces laid out in a neat grid with wide white gaps so none touch or overlap. One plain solid white background, with no labels, no ground shadow and nothing else in the image. No text and no numbers.
Keep the art simple and readable at small mobile-game icon sizes. Broad smooth shapes, clean even dark-brown outlines, only 2 or 3 soft shading tones per surface and one or two simple highlights. NO fine texture, intricate veins, realistic surface detail, excessive reflections or ornamental detail. A polished cute cartoon, not a highly rendered illustration. Keep the requested composition and isolated pieces.
